labels.label: bzthm:c1s1_revetement_universel_divisible
labels.notes: MARKED, closed. Printed sentence (transcription l.432-433, checked against the scan, journal p. 238 = PDF p. 11, which matches word for word): « Si V est une variété localement projective et compacte, son revêtement universel est divisible. » revetement_universel_divisible_proj assumes only [ChartedSpace (S n) V] [HasGroupoid V (projGroupoid n)] (the README's convention for « localement projective »), [CompactSpace V], [T2Space V], for any n, any universe and any base point v₀ : V. It concludes IsCoveringMap (proj V v₀), SimplyConnectedSpace (UniversalCover V v₀), HasGroupoid Ṽ (projGroupoid n), IsGXMorphism (GSR n) (S n) proj, and IsDivisible (GSR n) (S n) Ṽ. HYPOTHESES: T2 is plan F6's « variété », protocol in docs/CAMPAIGN.md, and it is the reading under which DEC-124, DEC-127 and DEC-128 accepted the § 2, § 3 and Theorem A marks (TheoremA.lean:30 carries the same row). Connectedness and second countability are dropped, so Lean is at least the paper. CONCLUSION: IsDivisible is the strict library's Déf. 15 (Classes.lean:312, already audited and marked): there is a subgroup of GXAut, i.e. of the homeomorphisms that are morphisms both ways, which satisfies Mathlib's ProperlyDiscontinuousSMul (ruled by DEC-120) and IsCancelSMul (« sans point fixe »), with a compact orbit quotient in the quotient topology. That is the printed definition, G₁ ⊂ G = the projective automorphisms. « SON REVÊTEMENT UNIVERSEL »: the conclusion itself pins Ṽ down as a simply connected covering of V, which for the paper's connected V is the universal cover, whatever the construction. Its structure is the pulled-back one, and that is the paper's own sentence on the same page (l.402-404: « tout revêtement R de V est une variété localement projective », « l'unique structure telle que la projection soit un morphisme »). Since HasGroupoid and IsGXMorphism proj are both in the conclusion, Ṽ carries the unique such maximal atlas (strict existsUnique_pullback), and GXAut is chart-independent under HasGroupoid (exists_smul_eq_of_mem_maximalAtlas). So the result does not depend on how the charts were chosen. pp.explicit shows that the HasGroupoid, IsGXMorphism and IsDivisible conjuncts all use the same instance, UniversalCover.instChartedSpaceProj, and a probe proves that instance rfl-equal to pullbackChartedSpace along the covering. The theorem holds for EVERY base point, and isDivisible_of_isCoveringMap_proj covers EVERY simply connected covering N → V, with no HasGroupoid V needed. So neither 'one base point' nor 'one model of the universal cover' narrows anything. The affine case (revetement_universel_divisible_aff) goes beyond the printed sentence (p. 238, « en remplaçant S(n) par Rⁿ »). NOT VACUOUS: the satisfiability example V = S(n) typechecks, and IsDivisible is non-trivial for a non-compact Ṽ. READINGS: none is new or load-bearing. (1) « variété » is F6 and already accepted. (2) The base point and the pulled-back structure are covered for all choices, and the structure is the paper's own. (3) G₁ = deck group is a proof choice, because the paper's divisibility is existential. The non-identification of deckAut with π₁(V, v₀) is disclosed and does not bear on the statement. No DEC row is needed, and the mark is not premature.

build.details: No other lake build was running (pgrep). `lake build --no-build BenzecriScaffold.Port.UniversalCover BenzecriScaffold.UniversalCoverRow`: 'All targets up-to-date (2663 jobs)', so the closer's oleans match the sources and nothing upstream moved. `lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true` on both files: exit 0, no output. A deliberately false probe confirmed the command does report errors. In code and prose, both files contain no occurrence of sorry, admit, axiom, unsafe, implemented_by, native_decide, extern, opaque, set_option or private. Axiom probe (`import Benzecri` + both modules): all 37 names in REPORT decls ∪ extra_decls resolve. 34 depend on exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Three depend on [propext, Quot.sound]: deckAut, IsGXMorphism.of_comp_eq and deckAut.ofHomeomorph. The REPORT says 'only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]'; that is a harmless overstatement, since a subset is still standard. Instance probe in the same environment: #synth finds UniversalCover.instChartedSpaceProj and instHasGroupoidProj; the instance is rfl-equal to the pull-back. Strict marked theorems consume the new instances without a mismatch: IsDivisible.isBalayable_proj applied to the row's conclusion, and prop2_developpement_proj (the developing map) on UniversalCover V v₀. isDivisible_of_isCoveringMap_proj specialised to the universal cover closes the same IsDivisible, so the `letI` form and the global instance agree. FCone's global affine instance still resolves. Importing Benzecri together with both modules raises no duplicate-declaration error. No instance on UniversalCover exists in Benzecri.*, because the type is new. The two global ChartedSpace instances, for models S n and Fin n → ℝ, can both fire only when V carries both charted spaces. That is the outParam pattern DEC-128 accepted for FCone, and no strict type does so today. Both probes were written under campaign/T-bz-universal-cover/ and deleted.
